# IStargatePool
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/stargate/IStargatePool.sol)

**Title:**
An interface for Stargate Pools

Stargate Pools are a type of IStargate that allows users to pool token liquidity.


## Functions
### deposit

Deposit token into the pool


```solidity
function deposit(address _receiver, uint256 _amountLD) external payable returns (uint256 amountLD);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_receiver`|`address`|The account to mint the LP tokens to|
|`_amountLD`|`uint256`|The amount of tokens to deposit in LD|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amountLD`|`uint256`|The actual amount of tokens deposited in LD|


### redeem

Redeem an amount of LP tokens from the senders account, claiming rewards.


```solidity
function redeem(uint256 _amountLD, address _receiver) external returns (uint256 amountLD);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_amountLD`|`uint256`|The amount of LP tokens to redeem|
|`_receiver`|`address`|The account to transfer the|


### redeemable

Get how many LP tokens are redeemable for a given account


```solidity
function redeemable(address _owner) external view returns (uint256 amountLD);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_owner`|`address`|The address of the account to check|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amountLD`|`uint256`|The amount of LP tokens redeemable, in LD|


### tvl

Get the Total Value Locked in the pool.


```solidity
function tvl() external view returns (uint256);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The total value locked|


### poolBalance

Get the available balance of the pool


```solidity
function poolBalance() external view returns (uint256);
```

### lpToken

Get the address of the LP token


```solidity
function lpToken() external view returns (address);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`address`|The address of the LP token contract.|


### sharedDecimals

Get the shared decimals of the pool


```solidity
function sharedDecimals() external view returns (uint8);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint8`|The shared decimals of the pool|
